newsitem.title: USA: Tree limb breaks, crushes two U.S. children.
newsitem.headline: Tree limb breaks, crushes two U.S. children.

text.p: A huge tree limb broke off and crushed an unsuspecting teenage girl and a baby late on Wednesday, authorities said Thursday.
Tiffany Gunn, 14, and her eight-month-old nephew Darrell Gunn were killed when the limb, one foot (0.3 metre) in diameter, crashed down from an ash tree onto their heads, the local coroner said.
The accident in the Chicago suburb of Maywood, Illinois, occurred on a calm night and there were no signs of rotten wood, according to local media reports.
